• Must be bought from the Armory as part of the Drone controller upgrade and can't be fielded by themselves.

Drone protocols: Drones are ignored when determining the unit's most used Toughness and Defensive rules. They move as fast as the unit they are attached to and only use the attached unit's movement restriction. They are considered as being part of the model that controls them. Drones controlled by a Drone controller can not be removed as casualties.
Accelerator: Pulse Accelerator Drones increase the range of all pulse weapons in the unit by 6". Cumulative with itself.
Environmental scan: Enemy units charging a unit with a Warscaper Drone have to make a dangerous terrain test after their Charge move. Cumulative with itself.
Grav inhibitor: Grav Inhibitor Drones reduce enemy Charge movements that target the model or its attached unit by 2". Cumulative with itself.
Shielded: Units that contain a Shield Drone gain a Ward(6+) against ranged attacks. A second Shield Drone grants Ward(5+) against ranged attacks instead.
Shrouded: Units that contain a Stealth Drone can't be targeted by enemies outside of 18" range. A second Stealth Drone reduces that range to 12".
